Mamata Banerjee faces protests, slaps worker amid political warnings

West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee's protest march in Kolkata was disrupted when eggs were thrown at her, accompanied by chants of "thief." In a separate incident captured on video and widely shared, Banerjee appeared to slap a Trinamool Congress worker during the protest. Meanwhile, Banerjee issued a stern warning to dissident party leaders, telling them to either remain with the TMC or join the BJP, stating that betrayal had emboldened the BJP.
